full_prompt_en: A square dusk photograph depicts a white modern house nestled among tall pine and deciduous trees. The main volume occupies the right half of the frame, its smooth plaster facade curving gently around an upper corner and bending toward a narrow dark window. A flat roof with a small chimney cap rises above it. To the left, a long glass-walled upper room stretches horizontally behind a slim white balcony edge, its warm wooden frames visible through the trees. Below, a covered terrace opens toward the viewer on thin posts, with amber interior lights revealing furniture and timber surfaces. A broad corner window wraps around the right ground floor, showing another warmly lit room. A short set of dark entry steps and a small potted plant sit just beneath it. The foreground is a gray pebble-paved path leading from the lower center toward the terrace, bordered by lawn and deep green shrubs. Dense branches frame the left and upper edges; tall trunks rise behind the building at right. The camera views the house from a slight low angle and three-quarter position, making the white curve and projecting horizontal slabs clear. A pale evening sky provides cool soft ambient light, while many interior lamps create amber pools behind the glazing. The smooth white surfaces contrast with vertical bark, textured foliage, dark wood, and the granular paving. The composition feels open and domestic, with the quiet path drawing the eye into a warm center under the dark forest canopy.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形暮色照片描绘一座坐落在高大松树和阔叶树间的白色现代住宅。主体占据画面右半部，平滑灰泥立面在上角温柔转弯，弯向一道狭窄深色窗。其上是平屋顶和小烟囱帽。左侧一间长长的上层玻璃房在细白阳台边缘后水平延伸，透过树木可见暖木色窗框。下方带顶露台以细柱向观者开放，琥珀色室内灯显出家具和木质表面。一道宽大转角窗绕过右侧底层，露出另一间暖亮房间。窗下是短短的深色入口台阶和一盆小植物。前景灰色小石铺路从下方中央通向露台，两边是草地与深绿灌木。茂密树枝构成左边与上边框，右侧建筑后面升起高直树干。相机从略低的斜侧三分之四位置观看住宅，使白色曲面与突出的水平板清楚可见。浅色傍晚天空提供冷而柔的环境光，多盏室内灯则在玻璃后形成琥珀色光池。平滑白面与竖直树皮、有肌理的枝叶、深木色和颗粒铺地形成对照。构图开放而有居家感，安静小路将视线引向黑暗林冠下温暖的中心。
style_prompt_en: The dusk photographic style balances smooth pale curved planes with dark vertical natural textures and broad horizontal projections. Warm light shines from transparent openings, creating welcoming amber pockets inside a cool blue-gray ambient setting. Clean white surfaces retain soft tonal gradation rather than hard contrast, while surrounding foliage and fine ground texture add visual grain. A three-quarter viewpoint reveals both gentle curvature and straight extending lines. Thin dark frames define glazed sections without overwhelming the larger forms. A low leading path or open foreground guides the eye inward, and irregular organic silhouettes frame the edges. Diffuse evening light leaves exterior shadows soft; interior lamps supply the clearest highlights and reflected warmth. The palette is restrained: ivory, charcoal green, gray, and honey amber. The whole image feels calm, functional, and intimate, its precise modern shapes softened by the textures around them.
style_prompt_zh: 这种暮色摄影风格平衡平滑浅色曲面、深色竖向自然肌理和宽阔的水平突出面。暖光从透明开口透出，在冷蓝灰环境中形成宜人的琥珀色区域。干净白色表面保持柔和明度渐变，而非生硬反差；周围枝叶与细碎地面肌理增添视觉颗粒。斜侧三分之四视角同时展现温柔曲率和向外伸展的直线。纤细深色边框界定玻璃区域，却不压倒大形。低位引导线或敞开前景将视线向内带动，不规则有机轮廓围住边缘。漫射傍晚光让外部阴影柔软，内部灯具提供最清楚的高光和反射暖意。色盘克制，由象牙色、炭绿、灰色与蜜琥珀组成。整幅图沉静、实用且亲密，精确现代形状被周围肌理柔化。
theme_en: A white curved modern house among tall forest trees at dusk
theme_zh: 暮色森林高树间的白色曲面现代住宅
name: Alvar Aalto
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
